# Aseprite files saved by Aseprite

Six of the `asefile` crate's test files (https://github.com/alpine-alpaca/asefile, `tests/data/` at commit 2274c35),
used as real-editor files for the native reader (`src/aseprite_file.rs`): RGBA, grey, indexed, the old palette chunk,
linked cels, layers and tags, and a tilemap the reader must refuse. They are MIT-licensed: see `LICENSE` here
(Copyright (c) 2020 Alpine Alpaca Games).
